# Lauren Kasten

> Lauren Kasten helps small business owners build simple systems around what they actually want, for the business and the life it's running on. She is a former elementary teacher, fitness coach and manager, and recruiter based in the Twin Cities, Minnesota. Her business entity is ACRO Consulting LLC.
